ruleset.name: search-index-alias-public-methods
ruleset.description: Public-method-count check, exempting Facades, Factories, Bridges and EntityManagers: Spryker's own architecture gives every module Facade one public method per business-layer capability, every Factory one create*() per collaborator it wires up, every Bridge one passthrough method per method on the facade it bridges, and every EntityManager one method per persistence operation the module needs — a high count in any of these reflects the framework's own DI/persistence conventions, not a design problem this package can fix. Run as its own phpmd invocation, separate from phpmd.xml — see that file's description for why.
